As a backend engineer with six years of experience at Northwind Robotics, I developed and owned the order-routing service using TypeScript and Node.js, managing a high-throughput environment of approximately 2 million events per day. My work included deep expertise in PostgreSQL, including schema design, query tuning, and logical replication, ensuring data consistency and performance at scale. I successfully led a nine-month Strangler-fig migration from a monolithic architecture to an event-driven microservices system, achieving zero customer-visible downtime while reducing p99 checkout latency from 1.9 seconds to 340 milliseconds.

In my role as engineering lead at Vertex Logistics, I managed a team of five engineers across dispatch and billing product lines, driving technical strategy and delivery. I leveraged Kubernetes and Terraform to streamline service deployment, enabling reliable, repeatable, and scalable infrastructure operations. This experience strengthened my ability to balance technical excellence with team leadership and cross-functional collaboration.

I am drawn to Hollis Bank’s focus on core banking systems, where my background in building resilient, high-performance backend services aligns directly with the demands of financial transaction processing. My experience with event-driven architectures, database optimization, and infrastructure automation positions me to contribute immediately to the stability and evolution of your core systems.
